card.name: Inside big numbers and 'hundred'
card.fires_on: Digits partway through a multi-digit number (street numbers, case citations, page counts) and words like Fifty, Hundred(s) that start a large quantity. It fires before the number is finished.

modes.label: Middle digit of a number
modes.description: A digit inside a three- or four-digit number such as an address, citation or count.

modes.label: Hundred-type quantity words
modes.description: Words like Hundred, Hundreds or Fifty that begin a large amount.

card.writes: Promotes odd number-related and unit-like tokens (abbreviation, registers, Chinese measure words), so it suggests a number or quantity word continues.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of a long number or a word like hundred, when more of the number is still coming.
